title: Towing and Labor Coverage: Conditions for Reimbursing Service the Insured Arranges
content:
A roadside service that the insured arranges outside the company's provider network is reimbursed under **Towing and Labor Coverage** on receipts. These conditions are the same on all six Cardinal Point Towing and Labor packages ($50, $75, $100, $125, $150 and $200).

## Conditions

1. **Reimbursement on receipts.** A service the customer arranges is reimbursed on receipts.
2. **Time for submitting receipts.** Receipts must be submitted within 60 calendar days after the disablement.
3. **What a receipt must show.** An out-of-network receipt must show:
   - the provider's name;
   - the service date;
   - the service location;
   - itemized charges.
4. **Where receipts are submitted.** Receipts are submitted through the claims portal, by email or by mail.
5. **Time for issuing the reimbursement.** A reimbursement is issued within 10 calendar days after complete receipts.

## Quick reference

| Condition | All packages |
|---|---|
| Customer-arranged service reimbursed on receipts | Yes |
| Receipts submitted within | 60 calendar days after the disablement |
| Receipt shows | Provider name, service date, service location, itemized charges |
| Submission channels | Claims portal, email, mail |
| Reimbursement issued within | 10 calendar days after complete receipts |

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Disablement date | Receipts submitted | Calendar days after the disablement | Within 60 days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 March | 15 April | 45 | Yes |
| 1 March | 15 May | 75 | No |

## Points of judgement

- **Complete receipts.** The 10 calendar days for issuing a reimbursement run from complete receipts. A receipt that does not yet show all four items in condition 3, for example one without itemized charges, is not a complete receipt.
- **Channel.** A receipt sent by email meets condition 4 in the same way as one uploaded to the claims portal or sent by mail.
